lines.en: One stride carries me over a whole roof.
The ground sags under my foot.
Trees reach only my waist.
I walk slowly because I am this large.
Clouds drift past my shoulders.
I lift a leg and the wind moves first.
This forest is in my way.
I need not run to be fast.
Each step is a small quake.
I must look down to see my feet.
The ridge beside me is a mere step.
I turn and knock down two trees.
I stand, and the sky darkens.
One breath and the wind changes.
This size cannot hide.
The things below are so small.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住半片平原。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the plain.
Such quiet is rare.
My arm hangs longer than a tower.
I shift, and the air yields.
I hold it in. I will not roar.
This body is still growing.
The people far off look up at me.
I raise a claw, then set it down.
From here you look like an ant.

lines.zh: 你抬头，看得见我全貌吗？
lines.en: Looking up, can you see all of me?
I lower my head. It takes a while.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你的门还大。
lines.en: My eye is bigger than your door.
Do not run. I would have to bend.
You are rather hard to make out.
I crouch, and the ground sways.
I bring my face closer.
Speak up. I can hear you.
I open my mouth and the wind rushes in.
You may want to stand further back.
One palm could cover you.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里很小，还很倔。
lines.en: Small in my sight, and stubborn.
I do not mean to tread on you. For now.

lines.zh: 这么大，也会有看不清的东西。
lines.en: Even this large, some things stay unclear.
I tilt my head to one side.

lines.zh: 抬头说话，别在我脚下喊。
lines.en: Speak upward. Do not shout at my feet.
This wound is like a mosquito bite.
Half a step back and the ground moves.
Who is hitting me? So small.
I sway and the trees go down.
It hurts, and it is not nearly enough.
My hide is thick.
Again?
I raise a hand against the next blow.
That much blood means nothing.
That little?

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，连牙缝都不够。
lines.en: What you hold will not fill a tooth gap.
Set it down, then walk away.
The wind took it.
I reach out and catch nothing.
That amount means nothing to me.
I do not fight over scraps.

lines.zh: 你举得太高了，我看不见。
lines.en: You hold it too high. I cannot see it.
Eating it or not makes no difference.
You ran into my foot.
I shift and you nearly fall.
My leg is thicker than your house.
That force is not even a tickle.
I stop, lest I tread on you.
I lift a foot and step over.
Not so close. I turn slowly.
One sweep of my arm clears the trees.
Step back and the air flows again.

lines.zh: 这具身体，不太适合这种事。
lines.en: This body is ill suited to such things.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一段距离站着。
lines.en: We stand a distance apart.
It is shorter than I, and still tall.
I am moving gently. It is difficult.
Standing like this is enough.
Its breath is like distant thunder.
I reach out and only touch.

lines.zh: 这么大的两个，也会安静。
lines.en: Two this large can still be quiet.
Before dawn, we part.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，我怎么拿。
lines.en: How do I pick up something this small?

lines.zh: 我这么大，踩一脚就是一坑。
lines.en: My size alone leaves a crater per step.
In my palm it disappears.
It crumbled. Too fragile.
Dropped it. I cannot find it.
I search the ground for a while.
Such a thing is worth little.
No use. I toss it.
If you want it, pick it up yourself.
You will not get a mile.
One glance down and there you are.

lines.zh: 这么大一块地，你也没处躲。
lines.en: All this ground, and nowhere to hide.
I lift a foot. Time for you to move.
This time I am serious.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，我一步就到。
lines.en: One stride reaches where you stand.
I turn my body toward you.
The ground starts to rumble.
I am about to roar.
I tower over roofs on tiny feet.

lines.zh: 这么小的目标，也得踩准。
lines.en: Even a small target needs a sure step.
I do not like chasing. I like waiting.
You are walking right by my foot.
This time I will not miss.

lines.zh: 十一格高的我，影子先压住你。
lines.en: Eleven blocks tall, my shadow pins you first.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，树挡不住我。
lines.en: Hide behind a tree. It will not stop me.

lines.zh: 我一脚下去，那片林子就没了。
lines.en: One stomp and that grove is gone.
I am narrowing your path.

lines.zh: 风帮我把你的气味送来。
lines.en: The wind carries your scent to me.
You run fast. I see it clearly.
One roar and your legs will weaken.
I raise both arms.

lines.zh: 这一片都在我的范围里。
lines.en: All of this is within my reach.
You have backed to the cliff.
One more step and you fall.
I am patient. Choose.
Little thing. Nimble, at least.
I bend down. This takes time.
Slow is still fast enough.

lines.zh: 我把手摊开，罩住这片地。
lines.en: I spread my hand over this ground.

lines.zh: 你抬头，看见的只有掌心。
lines.en: Look up and all you see is my palm.
The ground splits and you are thrown up.
One stomp and it all caves in.
I swing my arm and the trees fall.
Small blasts drop from my fingers.
The shock wave throws you far.
I have you.
I squeeze once, then let go.
Did you hear the ape's roar?
That sound shakes miles around.

lines.zh: 巨掌落下，地面凹了一块。
lines.en: My giant palm falls and the ground caves in.

lines.zh: 我抬手，落下的是一片影。
lines.en: I raise my hand; a shadow falls.
This is the gap between us.

lines.zh: 十一格高，我还没用全力。
lines.en: Eleven blocks tall, and still not full strength.
Shall we do that again?
I part the clouds as I come.
I land and the ground caves in a ring.
Who made me this size?
I look up. The sky is very near.
I flatten a whole row of trees.
The air rumbles in my lungs.
I move, and the hills echo.
I cannot see my own feet.
This world cannot hold me.
I crouch down slowly.

lines.zh: 远处的人大概都看见了。
lines.en: Those far off must have seen.
I breathe and the clouds shift.
A shadow this large cannot hide.
I lift a claw and flatten the grass.
My call carries a long way.
This step counts as the beginning.

lines.zh: 火在我身上，像一根火柴。
lines.en: Fire on me is like a single match.

lines.zh: 我砸下去，整片山谷都响。
lines.en: I crash down and the whole valley rings.

lines.zh: 水淹到我脖子，我拼命抬头。
lines.en: Water reaches my neck and I strain to lift my head.

lines.zh: 炸开的火球，只到我膝盖。
lines.en: The fireball reaches only my knee.
A small barb sticks in my hide.

lines.zh: 这股咒力，压得我喘不上气。
lines.en: This hex presses the breath from me.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我这具身子也发虚。
lines.en: Starved long enough, even this body weakens.

lines.zh: 雷落在我头上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my head and I flinch.
Nothing underfoot. I am falling.
